description: This source file implements a development runner for Pipecat bots, supporting multiple transport types such as Daily, WebRTC, and telephony (Twilio, Telnyx, etc.). It sets up a FastAPI server with various routes for WebRTC, webhook handling, and telephony WebSocket connections, and includes command-line argument parsing for configuration. It also contains logic for running bots directly or via server, managing dependencies, and integrating with external services like Daily and WhatsApp.
